title: Bringing your Excel data into the office

cues.text: Find the import centre, the order to import in, and the template for each kind of record: in English, in Arabic or with your current data.
Import from Excel, under Office, brings what you keep in spreadsheets into the office: contracts, brands, employees and more.
Four steps: download a template, upload your file, check every row, then import. Every import can be undone.
Import in this order: each step can refer to the ones before it, like leases to their brands and units.
Each card shows how many records are already in the system and when they were last imported.
Open the one you need. Here, leases.
Download the template in English or in Arabic, or With current data to edit what is already here and import it back.
In the template, lists such as units and brands are dropdowns, each column title has a note, and there is an example sheet and a read-me sheet.
The columns are listed here too: which are required, which one finds an existing record, and the values allowed.
When your file is ready, drop it here. Nothing is saved until you have checked every row.
